rounds.scope: Finite linear passive two-mass mechanical model; exact energy identity plus finite-time numerical verification.
rounds.finding: Input work 0.0949329661 J accounts for storage 0.0151181762 J and dissipation 0.0798147903 J. Independent quadrature, matrix exponential and closed-form phasor checks agree.
rounds.nextReason: Energy closure does not identify what a spectral peak measures; select a measurement-map test.

rounds.scope: Calibrated or uncalibrated damped-oscillator transfer/PSD surrogate; not an Earth or physiological model.
rounds.finding: The same poles yield displacement peak 6.6133 Hz versus velocity peak 8 Hz in a selected case. Unknown forcing permits exact output ambiguity; calibrated known forcing recovers the parameters.
rounds.nextReason: A sign need not identify a cause; test inherited alchemical visual-sign-to-composition inference.

rounds.scope: Exact synthetic two-channel, three-component linear observation map with nonnegative relative amounts.
rounds.finding: A continuous composition family has identical two-channel signals. Independent third assay restores rank 3; a duplicate leaves rank 2. Exact rational algebra and all stored fiber samples agree.
rounds.nextReason: Noise-free uniqueness is insufficient; test near-duplicate assay conditioning and bounded errors.
rounds.withheld: Actual identification of Newton compounds or a theorem that an independently measured total amount cannot identify the example.

rounds.scope: Fixed synthetic assay scaling and separately bounded absolute channel errors; no clipping or hidden normalization.
rounds.finding: Near-duplicate assay recovery amplifies c3 error to 2 delta/epsilon despite full rank. At delta=0.001 and epsilon=0.001 the exact bound is 2; independent third-channel bound is 0.001.
rounds.nextReason: Even stable measurements can be cherry-picked across many hypotheses; test familywise selection bias.
rounds.withheld: A universal ranking of real sensors or a physical chemical result.

rounds.scope: Ideal valid uniform null p-values under independent and perfectly correlated test families, with exact probabilities and a seeded illustration.
rounds.finding: Twenty independent nominal 5% tests produce at least one false positive with probability 64.1514%; Bonferroni gives 4.8830%. Duplicate correlated tests require different accounting.
rounds.nextReason: Apply dependence and selection control to the user-requested final dream/astral-information measurement question.
rounds.withheld: Empirical false-discovery rates for an unexamined literature corpus or posterior probabilities of extraordinary claims.

rounds.scope: Synthetic four-category target-test calibration; no participant, dream-state, clinical or astral-travel observations.
rounds.finding: Fixed 40-trial cutoff is 16 hits, with exact null rejection 2.6244884%. Naive repeated looks raise crossing probability to 14.0373194%. Disclosed leakage raises detection without identifying an extraordinary mechanism.
rounds.nextReason: Six authorized adaptive rounds are complete. Stop research rounds; finish source repairs, integration and release verification.
rounds.withheld: Evidence of astral travel, objective REM/lucidity from a browser timer, or genuine target concealment in a public static frontend.
